findings.message: Multiple audible <audio>/<video> elements on track 3 overlap (assets/voice/sakhi-q06.wav at 16.6-45s, assets/voice/sakhi-danger.wav at 25.8-45s). This causes layered audio playback.
findings.fixHint: Use non-overlapping time windows or different track indices.

findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#s3-today" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.
